name: Rimshot
description: Ride the rim of a vector tunnel and shoot down its lanes on the beat; the track is yours. Inspired by Tempest.

controls.action: Move round the rim (A, D too)
Point at a lane; hold left to fire
Touch: turn the ship; fire is automatic
Pad: move, fire (B hop, X zap)
Start or ready in the lobby

help: Shoot what climbs the lanes before it reaches the rim. Two kills in a beat raise the multiplier; three lanes on one beat make a chord. Fill Resonance for Overdrive. Hop on the beat for more. Pulsars burn their lane on the bar line; shoot spikes before the warp. Pick a mod after every zone. Friends share ships and can revive you.
